sections.A: Joint replacement mein advanced arthritis wale jor ki ghisi hui sathein masnoi parts se badli jati hain.
sections.B: Surgery se pehle plan samjhayein, exercises aur walker ki practice karwayein aur ghar ka jaiza lein.
sections.D: Vital signs, dard, zakhm, aur nerves aur khoon ka check (TKA ke baad peroneal, THA ke baad sciatic nerve).
sections.G: THA ke baad achanak hip dard aur taang chhoti aur mudi (dislocation), pindli mein dard aur sujan (DVT), ya zakhm ka infection: urgent.
sections.H: Day 0-1: stability check, phir baithna, khada hona aur frame ke saath chalna. Phir crutches ya stick, seerhiyan aur ghar.
sections.I: TKA: extension (heel prop, quadriceps sets) aur flexion (heel slides) dono par kaam. THA: surgeon ki ehtiyat ke saath taaqat aur chalna.
sections.K: Sujan aur dard ke liye barf aur compression; TKA ke baad quadriceps ke liye NMES madadgar ho sakta hai.
sections.M: Range, TUG, 30-second chair stand, 6MWT, seerhiyon ka test aur Oxford ya KOOS/HOOS score dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Surgery ke din ya agle din chalna complications kam karta hai aur recovery tez karta hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
